The 1N B03 output follows row89 only to c108, steps down to right row90 RY031 +CLOCK PO-2; 4M D02 descends on its own adjacent rail at c114 to the separate row89 right continuation. ry021_right_rows_60_93.png shows 7M D02 descending to the row89 diamond, joining the DR021 +ROS DATA LTH BIT 09 line. review_notes.location: 7F B04 and 4F B04 to right row46
review_notes.evidence: Ungridded ry021_4F_c113_c114_long_raw.png shows plain 4F B04 descending on its own rail to a row46 rightward bend. The adjacent bank rail and lower row48 +ROS REG BIT08 diamond are separated; no row46/48 join exists. ry021_7F_B04_route_native.png shows the other end at the 7F B04 output and its row46 diamond into DR021 +ROS DATA LTH BIT 07.

Ungridded ry021_4J_c113_c114_long_raw.png shows the plain 4J D12 input descending on its own rail to a left-to-right bend at row69. ry021_right_rows_60_93.png shows that row ending at the 7J D12 native diamond and DR021 +ROS DATA LTH BIT 08 continuation. This rail crosses rows65/68 with plain pluses; the adjacent bank rail stays separate.

ry021_c183_7B7E_native_grid.png, ry021_c114_upper_bank_grid.png, and ry021_c90_92_upper_grid.png show separate lines: c183 from plain 7B D02 row12 bends left across row27 to the 2B-driven c114 diamond and 4B D11. The adjacent 4C B05 lead crosses c114 without joining, then descends on c113 to the separate row25 latch line. c184 from the distinct 2E-driven row26 +ROS REG BIT07 diamond descends into plain 7E B02 row33. Nearby 7C/7F branches cross without diamonds.

Native enlargement ry021_clock_not_block_detail.png clearly prints a ◇ directly between PO-1 and NOT BLOCK. It is embedded in the signal name, with no vertical stroke entering it, so it remains a literal label glyph and is not a wire junction.
Crops ry021_2B_height_native.png and ry021_bit07local.png / bit08local.png / bit09local.png confirm these ✲ OR boxes extend from their top rows through the ID at top+7; all retain ordinary bank c73.
Individual native local crops show plain unlabeled A outputs bending at c61 into the upper and lower inputs of each matching ✲ OR. All eight local routes are declared.
